name: Revit_GFA_Calculator
provenance: Reviewed and anonymized snapshot derived from the validated Revit GFA workflow referenced by product specification Issue #1.
applicability: Revit 2026 demo planning for Area Scheme, Area Plan, boundary-source comparison, Area placement, tags and schedule QA. Project policy still requires user confirmation.
rules: Area Plans do not create Area Boundary lines automatically.
Use exact Revit geometry to validate a boundary; never substitute a bounding box for a footprint.
Keep geometric coverage evidence separate from regulatory or GFA policy decisions.
Place Areas and tags at points verified to be inside a valid closed circuit.
Treat user edits and confirmed project rules as higher priority than a new AI inference.
